hardening.minimized_reason: Omit external tracing integrations and instrumentation, uvloop, runtime developer/test tools, and optional IBM Db2, Oracle, Cassandra and DuckDB drivers; retain native graph traces, SQLite, Chroma and common model clients.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Package the editor and API with coordinated wheel pins, Python 3.15 dependency overrides and a separately compiled fastuuid dependency.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
